verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Automations can run the Copilot cloud agent automatically, on a schedule or in response to repository events such as an issue being opened. This directly covers event-triggered actions, and @copilot mentions in PR comments act as an additional trigger. Missing for 10: detail on how rules are defined (conditions, filters, supported event types, configuration format), the range of actions beyond launching the cloud agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
